Message:
sched/core: Add ENQUEUE_NOCLOCK to ENQUEUE_RESTORE

In all cases, ENQUEUE_RESTORE should also have ENQUEUE_NOCLOCK because
DEQUEUE_SAVE will have done an update_rq_clock().
